0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Bulls on the road in Toronto. Chicago's Nic Claxton is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and is a game-time decision, while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Chucky Hepburn and Nate Bittle are both day-to-day and game-time decisions with hamstring and foot injuries. The Bulls lost all three games to Toronto in the 2025-26 season series, including a 139-109 defeat in Chicago on March 18, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Chicago a 25% chance to win.
